text_block_list.text:
It turns dark out before we know it as we
train for
the Satsuki Sho. And then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, it's Ryan! Hello, hello!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Ines...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
We unexpectedly come across her
roommate, and
rival, Ines Fujin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you done for the day, Ines? Heading
back to
the dorm already?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I have a meeting with my trainer after
this, so we
may not be able to have
dinner together.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! Well then, guess I'll be dining
alone
tonight.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
We'll have to wait till tomorrow to do
our
pre-bed stretches too. ♪
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
They share a room and are both into
working out,
so it sounds like they have
a daily routine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ines... You surprised me. I didn't expect
you to
take the initiative like this.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, my breakaway speed is what I'm
known
for. ♪
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
But it does make sense that you didn't
expect it.
We never really talk about
stuff like that.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't like to bring the
competition into
our room.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
And I have my own goals, of course. It'd
be pretty
boring if I was always just your
buddy sidekick.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Also... I'm a little jealous.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because all Ryan ever talks about
is
McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I'm your friend, but I'm also your rival. So
I hope I
can become interesting enough
for you to see me
more as a racer.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
What? You're interesting, Ines! Really, I
promise!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? If so, then you won't just
ignore me
when I take the lead at the
Satsuki Sho, will you?
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna break away as fast as I can, so
I hope
you come and tackle me. ♪
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
What? ...I don't think that'll work in a
race.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I was just kidding. But really, I
want you to
come at me like you're
trying to.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm heading back. I'll leave the
door
unlocked for ya!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin leaves with a bounce in her
step as she
goes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A race against Ines, huh? And at the
Classics...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
She's always been by my side. We've
shared so
many happy moments
together.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the Twinkle Series is really
something,
isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
When I think of how I'll be competing
against my
own roommate, I...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It's not that... But it does feel a little
strange.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
This is really what life at the academy is.
I've
never realized it until now.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
When friends have to compete against
each
other, immeasurable levels of both
happiness and
sadness inevitably lie
ahead...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан gazes at the track as the
lights dim.
The finish line in the distance
is no longer visible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
